verdict.rationale: Ashby ships multiple AI-generated insight/suggestion features inside the product: AI candidate rediscovery scanning against job criteria (ashby-docs-1), Ashby Assistant that analyzes pipelines and surfaces candidate sentiment/concerns from interviews on request (ashby-docs-14, ashby-docs-33), and AI Notetaker that transcribes/summarizes interviews (ashby-docs-15). These are first-party documented, in-product capabilities rather than external tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and no community corroboration of the assistant's analytic accuracy.
